The Foreign Information Manipulation and Interference (FIMI) Taxonomy
v4.1 documents the architecture of state-sponsored information
manipulation operations. It catalogs 9 strategic functions, 105+
mechanisms, 7 structural terrain factors, and 8 channel types into a
navigable, cross-referenced knowledge base.

## Functions

The strategic purposes behind information manipulation.

::: {#functions-listing}
:::

## Mechanisms

The specific tactics and tools used to carry out each function.

::: {#mechanisms-listing}
:::

## Structural Terrain

Environmental conditions shaping vulnerability or resilience.

::: {#terrain-listing}
:::

## Channel Types

Platforms and media through which manipulation is delivered.

::: {#channels-listing}
:::

Lab.
